name: Chatbot-Chatgpt Tạo Video Nông Nghiệp, Hạt Giống, Cây Trồng
description: Quảng cáo nông nghiệp hiện đại kiểu điện ảnh: hook vấn đề → giải pháp (sản phẩm/công nghệ) → cách dùng → trước/sau → hero shot 3 lợi ích → CTA. Dùng cho hạt giống, phân bón, máy móc, phần mềm

prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 short advertising video inspired by modern AI technology + agriculture commercials.
Create a fast-paced, visually impressive short video that immediately attracts attention and explains the value of {SanPham} in a simple way.
- Warm sunlight, blue sky, fresh natural colors.
- Combination of traditional farming and modern technology.
- Optimized for TikTok, Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts.
Do not make the video feel like a static slideshow.
Every scene must contain visible action, camera movement or transformation.
Open with a beautiful wide aerial shot of a large Vietnamese farm.
Camera rapidly flies forward above rows of crops.
A farmer wearing a Vietnamese conical hat stands among the crops and looks at the field.
The farmer sees weak plants, yellow leaves or uneven crop growth.
show a smartphone, computer interface, AI assistant, analytics dashboard or automated system.
If the subject is an agricultural product:
show the product package clearly in the farmer’s hand.
Add futuristic but subtle visual graphics:
Show the product being used in real life.
- farmer takes a photo of a plant
- fertilizer granules fall onto the soil
- plants rapidly become greener and healthier
Use visual transitions synchronized with the music.
healthy crops, productive farm, efficient workflow, successful farmer.
Use a sweeping camera transition across the field.
Plants become lush, green and full of fruit.
If appropriate, show agricultural drone technology flying overhead.
“Đơn giản hơn – nhanh hơn – hiệu quả hơn.”
Large keywords appear one by one:
Place the product in the foreground.
beautiful green farm during golden sunlight.
Camera slowly rotates around the product.
Add subtle floating leaves or light particles.
Show 3 key benefits beside the product:
Show the farmer standing confidently in the successful farm.
He holds or points toward the product.
End with a smooth cinematic zoom-out showing the entire green farm.
Farmer should naturally walk, inspect crops, touch leaves, use the product or interact with technology.
Modern energetic advertising background music mixed with subtle countryside ambience.
Vietnamese male or female commercial voice.
Large, bold, highly readable Vietnamese typography.
Maintain the same farmer throughout the video.
Maintain the exact product packaging throughout all scenes.
Do not modify product logo, colors, text or proportions.
Avoid deformed hands, duplicated people, distorted plants, incorrect Vietnamese text or floating objects.
